title: VersaTex Multi-Purpose Rubber Floor Mat for Indoor or Outdoor Use, Utility Mat for Entryway, Home Gym, Exercise Equipment, Tool Box Liner, Garage, Under-Sink, Patio, and Door Mat; 30" x 48", Black
features: PROTECT FLOORS FROM DAMAGE: VersaTex mats protect entryway flooring. The front door mat can be used in any entrance to replace rugs and welcome mats. Safe to use on any hard floor or carpeted surface, VersaTex mats can be installed on wood floors, tile, concrete, low pile carpet, or other flooring types.

DURABLE RECYCLED RUBBER MAT: Your VersaTex mat is made from recycled rubber materials in the USA. Waterproof and easy to clean, the non-porous door mat will repel water and dirt. The strong floor mats for home or businesses won't rip or tear, and are lightly textured.

INDOOR OUTDOOR MAT: These rubber mats are perfect to use as an inside door mat or outside door mat. Perfect as a kitchen mat to protect the surfaces under the sink from water, cleaners or soaps, place as a back door mat outdoors, or under dog bowls.

EXERCISE EQUIPMENT MATS: Use the rectangular rubber mat under home gym equipment to protect flooring from wear and vibration. As an exercise bike mat, weight bench mat, recumbent bike mat, and stair climber mat, VersaTex mats protect the floor in your workout area, home gym, basement, or anywhere you workout.

USE ANYWHERE: VersaTex mats can be used to protect floors and surfaces in any environment: home, offices, lobbies, garages, home gyms, workshops, kitchen, patios, entryways, laundry rooms, craft rooms, and more! VersaTex mats are also easy to cut, so you can use them as toolbox drawer liners, on top of craft tables, as a workbench mat, or anywhere!
